screens.S_ENTRY: Outside the app: launcher, home screen, another app (search root)
screens.S_EXIT: Diary/Editor finished (Back on the root) or crashed; the process may survive (static QueryHandler, FileProvider.sCache kept)
screens.S_DIARY_PAUSED: Diary paused/stopped: Home, another activity on top (Settings, Editor, picker, chooser, print, permission dialog, browser), or mid-rotation
screens.S_DIARY_VIEW: Diary, MarkdownView shown (shown == true), Edit (pencil) button, no unsaved changes; menu main.xml without Cancel; Index/Add link hidden
screens.S_DIARY_VIEW_CHANGED: Diary, MarkdownView shown with unsaved changes (changed == true): Cancel (✕) visible. First start (help text) and after Add time/events/media/link
screens.S_DIARY_EDIT: Diary, EditText shown (shown == false), Accept (✓) button, no unsaved changes
screens.S_DIARY_EDIT_CHANGED: Diary, EditText after typing: Cancel (✕) visible, Accept saves
screens.S_DIARY_SEARCH: Diary with the SearchView expanded in the action bar; Find all appears when the overflow is opened. @VIEW: the query searches the MarkdownView; @EDIT: it highlights in the EditText
screens.S_DIARY_BROWSE: Diary, MarkdownView navigated away from the entry by a link (entry == false): Up arrow shown, Back goes back in the WebView history
screens.S_DIARY_PLAIN: Diary with Use markdown off: EditText only, no Accept/Edit buttons; Cancel appears after typing (entered through Settings)
screens.S_DLG_CALENDAR: CustomCalendarDialog (Use custom calendar on): month view with entry days marked, OK / Cancel. @GOTO from the menu, @SEND_* / @GEO for received media
screens.S_DLG_DATE_PICKER: Framework DatePickerDialog (Use custom calendar off), OK / Cancel
screens.S_DLG_SAVE_CHANGES: Alert "Save changes?" Save / Discard over Diary (Cancel item)
screens.S_DLG_BACKUP: Backup dialog: path EditText, Save / Cancel / Storage
screens.S_DLG_ADD_LINK: Add link dialog: title EditText, Add link / Cancel
screens.S_DLG_FIND_ALL: Find all result list (empty when nothing matches) with Cancel
screens.S_DLG_ERROR: Alert with an exception message and OK over Diary
screens.S_CHOOSER_SHARE: System share sheet for Share… @IMAGE (shown: PNG of the MarkdownView) / @TEXT (editing: the entry file)
screens.S_MEDIA_PICKER: System chooser + picker app for Add media… (GET_CONTENT */*); @PLAIN or @COPY (Copy images on)
screens.S_DOC_CREATE: DocumentsUI "save as" for Backup -> Storage (ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT application/zip)
screens.S_PERMISSION: Runtime permission dialog (GrantPermissionsActivity) over @DIARY or the Editor (@EDITOR_STYLES / @EDITOR_EXTERNAL)
screens.S_EDITOR: Editor activity (EditText, Accept ✓, Up arrow), no unsaved changes; @STYLES (Edit styles…/Edit script… for result) or @EXTERNAL (opened by another app)
screens.S_EDITOR_CHANGED: Editor after typing (Back asks Save / Discard); @STYLES / @EXTERNAL
screens.S_DLG_EDITOR_SAVE: Alert "Save changes?" Save / Discard in the Editor; @STYLES / @EXTERNAL
screens.S_SETTINGS: Settings activity + SettingsFragment (preferences.xml); Index page / Index template / Template page disabled until their checkbox is ticked. @<KEY>: right after that key changed
screens.S_DLG_INDEX_TEMPLATE: EditTextPreference dialog "Index template" (only with Use index ticked)
screens.S_DLG_THEME: ListPreference dialog Theme: Light / Dark / System
screens.S_DLG_ABOUT: About dialog (AboutPreference, layout about.xml) with OK
screens.S_HOME_WIDGET: Home screen with a Diary widget (header date, ◀ / ▶ / ⌄ today icons, entry text; layout widget.xml)
